description: This file defines the TreeCompiler class used to compile JMESPath expressions into PHP code, including methods for visiting different node types and generating source code.

classes.name: TreeCompiler
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling JMESPath expressions into executable PHP code by traversing AST nodes and generating corresponding PHP source code.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Main method to generate PHP code from AST, function name, and expression.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches AST nodes to specific visit methods based on node type.

methods.name: makeVar
methods.description: Creates unique variable names with a given prefix.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends formatted source code lines to the generated PHP source.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Reduces indentation level for source code formatting.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for source code formatting.

methods.name: visit_or
methods.description: Handles logical OR nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_and
methods.description: Handles logical AND nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_not
methods.description: Handles NOT nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_subexpression
methods.description: Handles subexpression nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_field
methods.description: Handles field access nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_index
methods.description: Handles index access nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_literal
methods.description: Handles literal value nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_pipe
methods.description: Handles pipe operation nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_list
methods.description: Handles multi-select list nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_hash
methods.description: Handles multi-select hash nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_function
methods.description: Handles function call nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_slice
methods.description: Handles slice nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_current
methods.description: Handles current node (no-op).

methods.name: visit_expref
methods.description: Handles expression reference nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_flatten
methods.description: Handles flatten/merge nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_projection
methods.description: Handles projection nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_condition
methods.description: Handles condition nodes in AST.

methods.name: visit_comparator
methods.description: Handles comparison nodes in AST.
